title: bupleurum olympicum var. oeneum
intro: Bupleurum olympicum var. oeneum, commonly known as the Chinese thorn or Golden Seal root, is a plant species used in traditional Chinese medicine. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum olympicum var. oeneum include its ability to clear heat, reduce inflammation, and tonify the liver and spleen, as well as its sedative and anti-anxiety effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saikosaponins, sesquiterpenes, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
